QuestInfo.name: The Beginner Pirate's First Training Session
QuestInfo.0: You're now a Pirate! Now what? Perhaps Kyrin can help you.
QuestInfo.1: Kyrin suggests monster hunting as a form of basic training. She wants you to hunt #r11 Pigs#k. There are apparently a lot of Pigs near Henesys. \n\n#o1210100# #r#a21931##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 11 Pigs and reported the results to Kyrin. No sweat!

0.0: 해적이란 직업이 아직 어색하지? 경험이 없으니 당연한거야. 경험이야 말로 정말 중요한 거라구. 아직 혼자서 경험을 쌓기는 힘들거야. 내가 약간 도와줄 수 있는데 수련을 하겠어? \r\n#L0##b 수련을 하겠습니다.#k#l \n#L1##b 스스로의 힘으로 할 수 있습니다.#k#l
0.1: 스스로의 한계를 인정할 줄 아는 마음이야말로, 더 강해지기 위한 바탕이 되지. 네가 강한 해적이 되도록 도와주겠어.

0.0: Is the whole Pirate job still foreign to you? That's because you don't have much experience as one. Right now, it may be a bit tough for you to gain experience on your own. I can help you a bit with that. Do you want to train with me? \r\n#L0##b Yes I will.#k#l \n#L1##b I can do it by myself.#k#l
0.1: The moment you accept your limitations, you are ready to break that barrier and go further than that. I'll make sure you'll become a more powerful Pirate than when you first walked in.
Maybe you're not ready to train yet...

yes.0: Still not used to using a Knuckler or a Gun? Try hunting the pigs first to get acclimated to the Pirates' way of hunting. Try hunting #r11 pigs#k first. The pigs can be easily found at the harbor of The Nautilus, so that should be easy. You can even find some nearby at Henesys.

no.0: Maybe you're not ready to train yet...

1.0: Great job slaying 11 pigs. This is only the beginning, though. You've only taken a baby step towards the mastery of Pirate.

yes.0: I'll let you know when I see that you'll need another set of training. In the meantime, keep training...and hopefully I'll see a different you the next time up.

mob.0: I don't think you have eliminated all #r11 pigs#k yet. If you want to become stronger, you'll need to put in the effort to do so.
